articles.title: Riyad Seif: A Life of Courage, Dignity and an Unfinished Dream
articles.excerpt: The Syrian Observer mourns Riyad Seif, one of the most respected figures of Syria's democratic movement and a symbol of principled political resistance. The post Riyad Seif: A Life of Courage, Dignity and an Unfinished Dream first appeared on The Syrian Observer.
articles.summary: 《叙利亚观察者》悼念里亚德·赛义夫，称他是叙利亚民主运动最受尊敬的人物之一、有原则的政治抵抗的象征，并称其梦想未竟。

articles.title: Can Tehran Escape the Shadow of Syria’s War?
articles.excerpt: The dispute between Damascus and Tehran is not over when relations might resume, but on what basis they can be restored. The post Can Tehran Escape the Shadow of Syria’s War? first appeared on The Syrian Observer.
articles.summary: 分析文章指出，大马士革与德黑兰之间的争议不在于何时恢复关系，而在于以何种基础恢复关系，并探讨叙利亚战争对伊朗的影响。

articles.title: From New York to Rural Aleppo: Are Women Safe in Syria?
articles.excerpt: Women in Syria are killed by fathers, brothers and husbands, yet the discussion so often turns to custom and tribal authority rather than law and institutions. The post From New York to Rural Aleppo: Are Women Safe in Syria? first appeared on The Syrian Observer.
articles.summary: 文章指出，叙利亚女性常被父亲、兄弟和丈夫杀害，但相关讨论多集中于习俗与部落权威，而非法律与制度，并追问女性在叙是否安全。

articles.title: Closer to Market Reality: What Syria’s Dollar Adjustment Means for the Economy
articles.excerpt: Sustainable economic, productive and fiscal stability remain necessary to stabilize the currency, al-Thawra writes. The post Closer to Market Reality: What Syria’s Dollar Adjustment Means for the Economy first appeared on The Syrian Observer.
